name: functions
description: Cloud Functions: the two onWrite aggregation triggers (transactions, transfers, budget rules), the PIN Callable Functions, and the auth onCreate trigger. See PRD-FIREBASE.md sections 6 and 10.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test lib/*.test.js lib/lib/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project dreda-emu-test "node --test functions/lib/integration/*.test.js"
